views.name: filtered_matches
views.body_sql: SELECT "id" AS "match_id", "duration" AS "duration", "winner_id" AS "wrestler1_id", "loser_id" AS "wrestler2_id" FROM "Matches"
views.description: Matches restricted to specific event types and result conditions.

views.name: named_matches
views.body_sql:
SELECT m.match_id, m.duration, m.wrestler1_id AS wrestler_id, w.name AS wrestler_name
FROM filtered_matches m
JOIN Wrestlers w ON m.wrestler1_id = w.id
UNION ALL
SELECT m.match_id, m.duration, m.wrestler2_id AS wrestler_id, w.name AS wrestler_name
FROM filtered_matches m
JOIN Wrestlers w ON m.wrestler2_id = w.id
views.description: Denormalized relation linking matches to competitor records to retrieve names.
